title: CRPF Constable Tradesman Recruitment 2026 - 9,195 Posts, Apply Before May 19
author: Ash K.
excerpt: Central Reserve Police Force has released a massive recruitment for 9,195 Constable Tradesman posts across various trades. 10th pass eligible. Online application closes May 19, 2026.
body: The Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) has announced a massive recruitment drive for 9,195 Constable (Tradesman) posts - one of the largest CAPF recruitment notifications of 2026. Online applications are open now and the last date to apply is May 19, 2026.

This recruitment covers multiple trades including Tailor, Cobbler, Cook, Water Carrier, Washer, Barber, Safai Karamchari, Carpenter, Painter, Plumber, Electrician, Motor Mechanic, Bugler, Pipe Band, Brass Band, and other technical trades. Candidates with 10th pass qualification and relevant trade experience or ITI certification can apply.

Age limit is 18-23 years as on the date specified in the notification, with standard relaxation for reserved categories (3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST). The selection process includes a Physical Standard Test (height and chest measurement), Physical Efficiency Test (1.6 km run, long jump, high jump), written exam, trade test, and medical examination.

CRPF is India's largest Central Armed Police Force with over 3 lakh personnel deployed across the country for internal security, counter-insurgency, and law and order duties. Constable Tradesman provides essential support services - cooking for battalions, maintaining uniforms and equipment, electrical and plumbing work at CRPF camps, and vehicle maintenance. Starting salary is Pay Level 3 (Rs 21,700 basic, total Rs 33,000-40,000/month) with free accommodation, food, medical, and CAPF allowances.

callout.heading: Apply before May 19 - don't miss this opportunity
callout.content: 9,195 posts is an exceptionally large number for a single CRPF notification. Apply online at the CRPF recruitment portal (rect.crpf.gov.in or crpf.gov.in). You need: 10th pass certificate, trade certificate/ITI diploma, Aadhaar card, passport photos, and application fee (Rs 100 for general/OBC, free for SC/ST/female/ESM). The physical test is demanding - start running and fitness training NOW if you haven't already.

faqs.question: What is CRPF Constable Tradesman salary?
faqs.answer: Starting basic pay: Rs 21,700 (Pay Level 3). With DA, HRA, and allowances, total monthly salary is Rs 33,000-40,000. Additional benefits include free accommodation in CRPF camps, free ration, CGHS-equivalent medical coverage for family, CSD canteen access, and travel allowances. After promotion to Head Constable (5-7 years), salary increases to Rs 25,500 basic.

faqs.question: What is the physical test for CRPF Tradesman?
faqs.answer: Male: 1.6 km run in 6 minutes 30 seconds, long jump 3.65 meters, high jump 1.2 meters. Female: 800m run in 4 minutes, long jump 2.7 meters, high jump 0.9 meters. Height: Male 170 cm (relaxed for hill areas), Female 157 cm. Chest: Male 80 cm with 5 cm expansion. Physical fitness is equally important as the written exam - many candidates clear the written but fail PET.

faqs.question: Which trades have the most vacancies?
faqs.answer: Cook and Tailor typically have the highest vacancies among CRPF Tradesman posts. Water Carrier, Washer, and Safai Karamchari also have significant numbers. Technical trades like Electrician, Plumber, and Motor Mechanic have fewer vacancies but less competition. Check the detailed notification for trade-wise vacancy breakdown.

faqs.question: Is CRPF Constable Tradesman different from SSC GD?
faqs.answer: Yes. SSC GD recruits General Duty constables for combat/security roles in BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, SSB. CRPF Tradesman recruits for support/trade roles within CRPF only - cooking, tailoring, electrical work, etc. SSC GD is conducted by SSC (common exam for all CAPFs). CRPF Tradesman is conducted by CRPF directly. Both offer similar salary and benefits but different work profiles.
